Peacebuilding humanitarian and development actors in Benishangul Gumuz hold quarterly coordination meetings both at the state and zonal levels and there is clear collaboration between actors efforts

A one day session on Conflict Transformation took place in May and more workshops are planned for the initial months of project year two.

description.narrative: Women and youth leaders have increased knowledge and skills on dialogue facilitation and conflict transformation
Number of women and youth facilitators leading community dialogues

comment.narrative: There is no clear data regarding the leadership roles of women and youth in facilitating community dialogue. In fact the activities carried out between 2021 and 2023 were largely public consultations and negotiations rather than structured community dialogues. Since no formal community dialogues took place during this period it is challenging to assess the leadership roles of women and youth in such processes.
